description: Selects one display/sort time per timeline item from all visible candidates. A projection, not new truth: every candidate stays visible and the selected one carries its basis and an uncertainty interval.

candidate_origins.stored: row in event_times written by an importer
candidate_origins.derived_legacy: computed on the fly from events.ts_start/ts_end/metadata of an event without stored candidates
candidate_origins.derived_observation: computed from source_observations (filesystem modification time) of the recorded artifact
candidate_origins.derived_correlation: start time of a call-log event linked by an ACCEPTED correlation hypothesis
candidate_origins.derived_artifact: time candidates of events attached to the same recorded artifact (for example filename-derived or EXIF observations)

precision_interval.description: A coarse precision widens the interval to the whole unit; the sort time is the start of the unit.

unknown_zone.description: A wall-clock time without zone is sorted as if it were UTC. The interval covers every real UTC offset: utc = local - offset with offset in [min, max] hours.

assumed_zone.description: Only when the operator passes assume_zone together with an assumption_rule id. Never applied silently. Per-source zones may override the default.

unusable_candidates.file_mtime_of_temporary_upload: source_observations whose metadata marks filesystem_stat_scope as a server temporary upload describe upload time, not the original file
unusable_candidates.unparseable: raw value retained; not usable for sorting

undated: Items without a usable candidate are listed separately and never sorted by import time (events.created_at).

legacy_derivation.description: Candidates computed for events that predate event_times. Keyed by event_type; 'default' applies otherwise.

lanes.phone_like_key: separators (space, dash, dot, parentheses) removed from values consisting only of digits, plus and separators; the raw value is kept for display

recording.description: Start-time candidates of a recorded artifact; transcript segments inherit them plus the segment offset.
recording.note: Events attached to the recorded artifact (artifact_id) whose event_type is listed here contribute their time candidates; another importer's type needs a new rule version.
